title: Cielo rooftop, tonight and this weekend
intro: Friday 9 Oct, past sunset already, so this is the late slot. Address: 5th floor, The Cube, Cooper Road, Kisementi, above Acacia Mall.

items.title: You and your boys, tonight
items.description: Arrive by 8:00 PM to take a table while it is still calm. The room turns loud from about 10:00 PM when the DJ starts, so eat and talk first, then stay if you want the music.
items.metadata: Expect 4 of you at roughly 120,000 to 250,000 total: 2 cocktails each at 12,000 to 25,000, plus light plates. Bottle service, if you take it, starts about 300,000.

items.title: What to book and wear
items.description: Weekends fill, so reserve a balcony table this afternoon. Smart casual is enforced, no slippers or vests. Ride home by Bolt or SafeBoda, sorted before you start drinking.
items.metadata: RSVP 0200 910300 or 0742 891 326. Open daily 4:00 PM to 6:00 AM. Card and mobile money both accepted at the counter.

items.title: Photo timing
items.description: Sunset today was 6:41 PM, so the city lights and the dark sky read best from about 6:45 to 7:30 PM. If you want the view rather than the music, that is your window and you can leave by 9:00.
items.metadata: Driving from central Kampala to Kisementi is 15 to 25 minutes in evening traffic, estimate only. No rooftop view tonight if you arrive at 8:00, only lights.

closing: Sunset 6:41 PM and Cielo's floor and hours are verified today. The shilling amounts are estimates from the July 2026 Kampala guide and the venue's own notes, not quoted prices.
